reviews.text: I and my family members visited on last Saturday night. Not much people on that night, therefore we just needed to be wait for about 5-10 minutes for the table. We also ordered rainbow roll and sushi set. The food tastes good and fresh . However, we were shocked again that they automatically adds a service charge to the bill. We enquired to the waitress and she confirmed us we have to pay the bill with service charge . In summary, the food was fine. Instead the price shows on the menu ,please pay attention they also have 10% service charges.

reviews.author: farial mahmud
reviews.text: Very disappointing experience at Maki & Ramen Meadowhall on Saturday 15 August, shortly after 6:30 pm. We visited as a family with our very young daughter and had brought a small amount of fried chicken for her because she would not eat the restaurant food. A staff member told us outside food was not allowed due to allergy/cross-contamination concerns. We would have completely respected the policy if it had simply been explained politely. Instead, the staff member was rude and condescending, continued lecturing us, and made a sarcastic comparison that bringing food for our toddler was like “going to a shoe shop with shoes.” The way we were treated made us feel singled out and uncomfortable, and honestly ruined the whole meal for us. After that interaction, we could not relax or enjoy the food at all. The behaviour also left us wondering whether we were being treated differently from other customers. Restaurant policies are understandable, but customers should still be treated with basic respect. I emailed Maki & Ramen management about this on 20 August and have not received a response yet.

reviews.author: Farial
reviews.text: Very disappointing experience at Maki & Ramen Meadowhall. We visited as a family with our very young daughter. Because she would not eat the food from the restaurant, we had brought a small amount of fried chicken for her. A member of staff told us she could not eat it because of allergy/cross-contamination concerns. If that is the restaurant's policy, we would have been happy to respect it if it had simply been explained politely. The problem was the way we were spoken to. The staff member became extremely condescending and started lecturing us, even making a sarcastic comparison along the lines of bringing food for our toddler being like "going to a shoe shop with shoes." There was absolutely no need to speak to customers like that. The whole interaction made us feel singled out, embarrassed and unwelcome. We left genuinely questioning why we were treated in such a hostile manner. Restaurant policies are understandable. Rude and disrespectful treatment of customers, especially a family with a very young child, is not. I have raised the matter directly with Maki & Ramen management and hope they investigate it properly.

They added the 10% service charge to the bill and then told me I could take it out; hate when people use cheap tactics to make you leave a tip for underwhelming food and basic service. reviews.author: Alexandra Racheru
reviews.text: The entrance is like a hallway from a horror video game. There is no one at the upper(street level) entrance at the reception. You walk down into what looks like it can be the beginning of the murder mystery. Once you get downstairs alive, you are greeted quickly by the staff which were nice. During the entire time we were there the ladies restroom had a paper on the door with a very “professional” hand written note: “Cleaning in progress” - at a restaurant this should not be out of order for longer than 15 min maximum. However it did not seem the have anyone cleaning so I pushed the door to enter because I want to wash my hands before eating, surprisingly there was no one cleaning anywhere. There are 6 toilets - 1st one had the door opened full of cleaning supplies in a very disorganised and dirty way, the 2nd & 3rd toilet were both Out of order with yet another very proper hand write note on them. Out of the other 3 toiles left - 2 were in an unusable state and only 1 was not completely gross and could be used. The food was mediocre at best, we were 3 people, we got 3 mains and 1 starter. They did serve the food very quickly- which makes you wonder a bit, however it was basic at best for some classic dishes. We paid around 25£ each and we will not return. I do not and will never recommend a place that does not keep their restroom clean. Unacceptable for central London!

reviews.author: Happy Traveller
reviews.text: Highly recommend Maki Ramen! I visited the Old Street branch for lunch and the staff, food and atmosphere is fantastic. I had walked past the first restaurant in Edinburgh where I learned about Maki Ramen, the founder's journey, story and philanthropy immediately captured my interest and intrigue. The menu is clearly geared toward inclusivity, there are halal, vegan, vegetarian options as well as an allergen list provided. Maki Ramen provides authentic asian dishes that I can actually try (halal) without compromising on taste. Prices are so affordable too! All the staff were lovely. Our interaction with Navin was particularly memorable. He is kind, friendly and knowledgeable. Me and my family had the most wonderful interaction with him. He genuinely cares about offering excellent service. He also spoke highly of the founder and the team he works with, it's so good to know that workplaces with a healthy and happy work culture exist. I hear that there are more branches opening in London (i.e Stratford, Westfield) and I look forward to visiting them!

reviews.author: Kieran Gandhi
reviews.text: Extremely Disappointing Experience Absolutely disgusting experience at Maki & Ramen in Southampton today. I have never experienced such poor service, especially when dining with children. My wife’s food and one of my sons’ meals arrived within a couple of minutes of ordering. Meanwhile, my food and all of our side dishes didn’t arrive until around 29 minutes after we ordered. By that point, my wife and one of my children had already finished eating. But the worst part was what happened with my two-year-old son. We specifically ordered a katsu chicken main without the sauce, so he could simply have the chicken and rice. We were told this could instead be ordered as two side dishes. Fine — we agreed. Yet when everyone else’s food eventually arrived, his food had not even been started. We waited a few more minutes before having to call someone over and ask where his food was. The server checked, and I could clearly see the cook looking through old tickets. It was obvious that the order had simply never been started. We were then offered his meal for free, but were told we would have to wait for it to actually be cooked. What exactly were we supposed to do? Wait another 20–30 minutes while my food went cold? My son is two years old. This is completely unacceptable. I asked for further compensation given the situation, and instead of showing any understanding, we were challenged repeatedly about it. At that point, I was so disgusted and frustrated that I didn’t even eat my own meal. It was taken away, and I left the restaurant having paid for a lunch where I effectively didn’t get to eat. What makes this even more frustrating is that I noticed other tables around us receiving their food together and being served normally. I am honestly left wondering whether people who look like me are treated differently in this restaurant. I sincerely hope that isn’t the case, but after today’s experience, I cannot ignore how it felt. This was supposed to be a family lunch, only a week before my birthday, and instead it turned into an incredibly disappointing and upsetting experience. The way my two-year-old was treated was particularly disgusting. There was no urgency, no proper explanation and very little empathy. We will never be coming back to Maki & Ramen. I would strongly encourage the management to look seriously at what happened here, because this is simply not acceptable customer service.

reviews.author: George
reviews.text: I visited this restaurant with a friend at lunchtime. There was no queue, but the restaurant was extremely busy. After being seated, we waited for around 10 minutes without anyone coming to take our order, and eventually had to stop a member of staff ourselves. There was also no QR code on the table for ordering. The food arrived quickly once we had ordered. The chicken pieces were very salty, and both my friend and I ordered the steak ramen. Unfortunately, both of us developed diarrhoea later that afternoon. We had not eaten anything else after our meal here, so naturally this was quite concerning. While I cannot say with certainty what caused it, the fact that we both experienced the same symptoms after eating the same meal was worrying. Overall, the combination of inattentive service, overly salty food and our experience afterwards made this a very disappointing visit. Btw, 12.5% service charge included.

reviews.author: Nicholas Srai
reviews.text: Dropping from 5 Stars to 1 Star due to shocking management service. I originally left a 5-star review after an incredible dinner, but returning Saturday evening almost before close completely ruined this venue for me. We stopped by just to give a friend a quick glance inside for a future visit. The doors were open and people were still eating, but the female manager was at the front host desk looking visibly frustrated while sorting something out. When I asked if we could show our friend around, she was extremely rude and hostile. When I clarified we didn't want a table, she shut us down with an awful attitude. The male host actually tried to intervene and say it was fine, but her hostility made us walk away completely disgusted. What makes this so disappointing is that on launch night, this exact same manager was boasting about how welcoming she is and how she treats all her staff "like her own children." The contrast between that fake charm and her actual demeanor was shocking. To top it off, chairs had already been stacked on tables all across the dining room while paying customers were still eating, making the place look messy and making guests feel rushed. Great food means nothing if management treats returning customers with total disrespect. I won't be back or recommending this place again.
